'''Blue Nine''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]]. During the [[ambush on Ral's Run]], Blue Nine's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] was targeted by [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] which were driven off by other pilots.<ref name="Stay on Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blue Nine appears in the opening story for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
